g01-l01.en: Tap the lines that cut the circle into two equal halves, then press Check.

g01-hint.en: Both pieces must be exactly the same size.

g02-l01.en: Drag the clock hands to show half past three, then press Check.

g02-hint.en: The little hand points between three and four; the big hand points down at six.

g03-l01.en: Tap two cards that make ten together. Pair them all, then press Check.

g03-hint.en: Three and seven make ten. What goes with nine?

g04-l01.en: Tap the empty part of the bond until seven and your part make ten, then press Check.

g04-hint.en: Count up from seven: eight, nine, ten!

g05-l01.en: Tap the letters to spell the word for this animal, then press Check.

g05-hint.en: It says woof. D — O — G.

g06-l01.en: Build the word with the two right chunks, then press Check.

g07-l01.en: Tap the apples from smallest to biggest!

g08-l01.en: Apple, banana, apple, banana… What comes next? Tap it!

g08-hint.en: Say the pattern out loud and listen for what follows apple.

g09-l01.en: Flip the cards and find all the matching pairs!

g09-hint.en: Try to remember where each picture hides.

g10-l01.en: Listen carefully, then tap the picture of the word you hear.

g10-hint.en: Tap the speaker to hear the word again.

g11-l01.en: Tap the dots in order, one, two, three… and see what you draw!

g11-hint.en: Find the next number and tap it.

g12-l01.en: The two pictures are almost the same. Tap what changed on the right side!

g12-hint.en: Compare the pictures square by square.

g13-l01.en: Tap exactly five apples, then press Check.

g13-hint.en: Count out loud as you tap: one, two, three, four, five.

g14-l01.en: Match each animal to its shadow, then press Check.

g14-hint.en: Look at the ears — they give the shadow away.

g15-l01.en: Tap every apple, count them, and tap the number, then press Check.

g15-hint.en: Mark each apple first, then count your check marks.

g16-l01.en: Put your finger on the orange dot and trace along the line!

g16-hint.en: Follow the line up and down — you don't have to be perfect.
